title: Welcome to the Real World: How You Live in Your Own Simulation of Reality — and How We Can Still Share a World. A Theory of Persistence, Emergence, Learning, and Correctable Intelligence
description: Evolution by Emergence is an open research corpus and machine-auditable candidate architecture for resource-constrained cumulative evolution. Version v23.2 keeps everything in v23.1: CORE.md opens with what a functional world model is and follows one model of learning, read as a network, in eight steps, and formalization/ebe-core/EbECore.lean audits 96 machine-checked results. It adds, outside the core, a working note on what one turn of learning consists of, with three core-Lean modules. In a model of learning as ruling out possibilities, in a world that stands still, it states a set of operations and conditions that are jointly sufficient for a learning turn; shows that an error which none of a learner's own operations tells from the truth survives its own honest turns, and can be removed by another learner with a different operation; separates being told a result from being taught an operation; and puts the same loop on a resource ledger. The work went through two outside reviews, the assistant's own adversarial review and an independent literature audit, all kept in the repository with the responses. The audit's judgment is accepted: the work is mainly a small formal reconstruction of known ideas (candidate elimination, observational indistinguishability, learning about methods, elementary resource accounting) and is not presented as new theory; no claim was judged a sharpening, and two counterexamples to its interpretation were accepted and corrected. The Discovarian creed gains two sections in draft, on what a learner does and what has to hold. A concept note proposes, as a proposal and not as law, a protected interest in a person's routes of correction under the safeguard that fallible is not incompetent; no lawyer has read it. Retained from v23.1: cooperative error identification, acting under time, models for acting in a changing world, and a working space on the Yang–Mills mass gap that is handed over to others and contains no mass-gap result. No human expert has reviewed the additions of this release. DIALOGUE.md records how the author and an AI assistant build the model together, now in 49 entries. The release title uses ‘simulation of reality’ to mean the internal model through which a system experiences and acts in the world, not a claim that reality itself is simulated. Formal verification establishes implications under explicit premises; empirical, causal, political and normative interpretations remain open. The original repository material is dual-licensed under CC BY 4.0 OR Apache-2.0 as documented in DUAL-LICENSING.md; CC BY 4.0 is supplied here as the single Zenodo archival metadata value because the GitHub-Zenodo metadata path accepts one license value.
